decision: Plan 2.3 safety/correctness rule. PASS iff all 20 normal runs complete with the probe checks (hash, relogin count, cookie/outbound boundary), both giant-after runs exit 0 without OOM and every request is rejected as too-large, and no (kind, concurrency) metric among p50/p95, CPU seconds, anon after and per-cell anon peak shows repeatable degradation (both series medians > before max + J).
